title: An intentionally long research title for testing truncation, complete hover names, and multi-line research details
summary: Large materials and six independent network requirements.
description: This research contains 32 material kinds. Redstone requires 16,384 items, so the material region must wrap into several rows.
Six independent resources have unequal totals. Their values, bars and percentages must remain separate when supplies are insufficient.
Use the research station list scrollbar and the overview detail scrollbar independently. A long number must not overlap the material name.
The title is deliberately longer than a page tab or node. Hover a truncated label to read the complete name.
This description is intentionally several paragraphs long to exercise the scroll area without moving the footer actions.
